rules.title: Never swallow errors
rules.text: Never swallow exceptions silently; handle them, or rethrow with added context.

rules.title: Typed errors
rules.text: Use specific error types or codes instead of string matching on messages.

rules.title: Validate at boundaries
rules.text: Validate all external input (HTTP, files, env, user input) at the boundary and trust typed data inside.

rules.title: Fail fast on config
rules.text: Fail fast at startup when required configuration is missing or invalid.

rules.title: Safe user-facing messages
rules.text: Return safe user-facing error messages; keep stack traces and internals out of responses.
